real_conflicts: The proposal to simply 'reduce the size' of the orange SVG circle is insufficient; the circle is a structural element of the feature block. Shrinking it without repositioning it to the right or backgrounding it (z-index) will still leave the primary scan path (the headline) obstructed, failing the mandate for efficient comprehension.
accepted: The consensus to fix the contrast of the feature title and excerpt (dark-on-dark) is accepted as a prerequisite for any structural analysis; without legibility, the hierarchy is moot.
The observation that the 'In this issue' sidebar is truncated by the subscription block is accepted as a critical failure of the 'compact contents' requirement.
concession: I concede that the 'Never miss an issue' block is currently too large for the right-hand column's vertical budget, but I reject moving it to the footer as it dilutes the secondary action's prominence. It must remain in the right column but be vertically compressed.
compromise: Implement a strict vertical budget for the right column: The 'In this issue' list must occupy the top 60% of the column height with reduced line-height to ensure all items are visible. The 'Never miss an issue' block must be compressed to the bottom 40% with reduced padding. Simultaneously, the orange circle in the feature block must be shifted 15% to the right and set to z-index: -1 (or behind the text container) to clear the headline scan path.
nonnegotiable: The 'In this issue' sidebar must display the full list of contents without being obscured or cut off by the subscription module; the table of contents is the primary navigational tool for the issue.
